description: Defines the class 'Image_Canvas_ImageMap' for handling HTML image maps, including methods for adding map areas, drawing shapes, and outputting the map as HTML.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_ImageMap
classes.description: Class for handling output as a HTML imagemap, extending 'Image_Canvas', with methods for adding map tags and rendering image maps.

methods.name: _addMapTag
methods.description: Adds an area tag to the image map with specified shape, coordinates, and parameters.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line and adds a corresponding map area if URL is provided.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon and optionally maps its vertices or the entire shape.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle and adds a map area if URL is provided.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse or circle and maps it if URL is provided.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice shape and maps it if URL is provided.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the image map as HTML if map areas exist.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the HTML image map to a specified file.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML for the image map with all map areas.
